findings.description: src/mcp/review-mcp.ts:658-674 advertises reason as an optional plain string and no longer encodes the conditional non-empty requirement for decision=could-not-confirm. The handler defense at lines 438-440 prevents persistence, but schema-driven clients and validators receive a weaker public contract; tests/review-mcp.test.ts:475-483 confirms only the later isError response. Restore a discriminated or conditional schema requiring a non-empty reason for could-not-confirm, retain the domain defense, and assert the tools/list schema.

src/mcp/review-mcp.ts:69-134 builds successful text from producer-controlled names, targets, notes, values, source references, excerpts, and rationale; lines 356-418 and 516-526 return it unchanged. The sanitizer at lines 718-740 is applied only to caught errors, so C0, C1, and bidirectional controls can survive in successful MCP text and spoof terminal or agent rendering. Sanitize every text content item at the final MCP result boundary and add hostile success-payload regression tests while preserving newline, tab, and carriage-return semantics.
